name: DCG Drifting Car Game
author: Unity Play
description: Drifting car game. Press "w" or "arrow up" to move forward. Press "s" or "arrow down" to move back. Press "a" or "arrow left" to turn left. Press "d" or "arrow right" to turn right. Press "v" to fly. I dedicate this game to my family and to the 2nd B class of Jesi.
